metadata.title: What Wave–Particle Duality Actually Means
metadata.thing: the possibility wave replacing the ball-with-ripples cartoon
metadata.long_title: What Wave–Particle Duality Actually Means — in about a minute | Bear's Notes
metadata.description_blurb: Duality in about a minute: the ball-with-ripples cartoon is dimensionally impossible; 'how do you travel?' gets stripes, 'where are you?' gets one whole dot; secret routes and smeared stuff both fail; what's left is one object — a wave of possibility, |ψ|² — and duality's real meaning: wave-shaped possibilities, particle-shaped results. Full explainer on the channel.
metadata.short_blurb: Duality without the ball-with-ripples cartoon, in about a minute. Full explainer on the channel.

beats.narration_text: Everyone draws the electron the same way: a little ball wearing ripples.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Everyone draws the electron the same way: a little ball wearing ripples.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] The popular cartoon: brown ball, concentric secondary ripples.

beats.narration_text: But a real electron's ripples are tens of thousands of times wider than the ball could be — the cartoon can't be the thing.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But a real electron's ripples are tens of thousands of times wider than the ball could be — the cartoon can't be the thing.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Brace over the ripples labeled '0.167 nm' (blue); tick at the ball labeled '÷ 60,000' (ink); the cartoon dims.

beats.narration_text: So ask the electron "how do you travel?" — many runs through two slits answer in stripes, a wave's signature.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So ask the electron "how do you travel?" — many runs through two slits answer in stripes, a wave's signature.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] Fresh canvas: compact gun/two-slit/screen lab; faint streaks fly; the blue striped curve draws along the screen.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create lab; lagged streaks; Create striped curve.

beats.narration_text: Ask "where are you?" — and each answer is one whole dot, never half an electron.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Ask "where are you?" — and each answer is one whole dot, never half an electron.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] One blue electron flies and lands as a single whole ink dot with a small flash.

beats.narration_text: "A particle with a secret route" fails: routes would pile into two heaps, not stripes.
beats.tts_normalized_text: "A particle with a secret route" fails: routes would pile into two heaps, not stripes.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] Dashed brown two-heap curve at the screen; hairline strike; both dim.

beats.narration_text: "A wave of smeared stuff" fails too: detectors never catch a fraction.
beats.tts_normalized_text: "A wave of smeared stuff" fails too: detectors never catch a fraction.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] A half-dot glyph near the screen; strike; then both struck stories fade away.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn half-dot; strike; FadeOut both struck groups.

beats.narration_text: The honest picture: between question and answer there is one object — a wave of possibility.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The honest picture: between question and answer there is one object — a wave of possibility.

beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] A clean blue wave packet appears at the gun and glides toward the slits — the one object.

beats.narration_text: Brighter wave, likelier dot — that map is psi squared.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Brighter wave, likelier dot — that map is psi squared.

beats.narration_text: Duality just means: wave-shaped possibilities, particle-shaped results.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Duality just means: wave-shaped possibilities, particle-shaped results.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] The packet reaches the screen and becomes one whole dot; in the top strip |ψ|² transforms into 'wave-shaped possibilities · particle-shaped results'.

beats.narration_text: The electron isn't sometimes wave, sometimes particle — always the wave in between, always a whole dot when asked.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The electron isn't sometimes wave, sometimes particle — always the wave in between, always a whole dot when asked.
